newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL'S SADIA H1 NET 40.5 MLN REAIS.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL'S SADIA H1 NET 40.5 MLN REAIS.

text.p: Brazilian food group Sadia Concordia S.A. on Wednesday reported the following first-half 1997 consolidated financial results.
Note: Figures are in Brazilian reais and are not adjusted for inflation.

In a statement, the firm said its first-half net profit rose 618.2 percent over the same period last year due mostly to a rise in productivity and shift towards added-value products with higher margins.
Consolidated sales were up 12.2 percent in the first half compared with 1996's first six months, it said.
Export revenues rose 44.5 percent in the period from the same period last year fueled by sales of poultry to Europe and Middle East and soybean exports, it added.
But domestic receipts only grew 5.1 percent as consumer debt and prices that rose less than inflation damped sales, the statement said.

In June, Sadia announced it was investing $37.5 million in a new factory in Ponta Grossa in the southern state of Parana to produce frozen pizzas and fresh pasta as part of its continued strategy over producing more value-added proucts.
